name: speckit-product-forge
description: Product Forge v1.5.0 — Full product lifecycle for My Zodiac AI (NestJS 11 + Vue 3.5 + Quasar 2.18 + MongoDB 7 + Redis 7 + Capacitor 8). Drives features from problem discovery through research, product-spec, planning, implementation, verification, testing, and post-launch retrospective across 29 skills. Supports three feature modes (lite / standard / v-model) and adds v1.5.0 phases: i18n-harvest, migration-plan, monitoring-setup, experiment-design, portfolio, backfill, and feature-flag-cleanup.
